name: Can a tubular skylight be installed on any roof type?

mainEntity.name: Can a tubular skylight be installed on any roof type?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tubular skylights can be installed on most common roof types, including asphalt shingles, tile, metal, and flat roofs. Specific flashing kits are available for different materials to ensure a watertight seal. The primary consideration is ensuring adequate space in the attic for the light tube and a suitable location on the roof that receives sufficient sunlight without major obstructions. A professional assessment can determine feasibility for unique roof structures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, tubular skylights can be installed on most roof types using specific flashing kits, provided there's attic space and good sun exposure.
